newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Aviation Sales started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Aviation Sales started as buy.

text.p: -- Dillon Read said it initiated coverage of Aviation Sales Co with a buy rating and set an 18-month price target of $27 on the stock.
-- said earnings growth for the aircraft parts distributor would be boosted by prosperity in airline industry and the increasing age of the world's aircraft fleet.
-- expects earnings growth of 12 percent a year over the next five years.
-- forecast 1996 earnings of $1.46 a share, and $1.80 in 1997.
-- Aviation Sales was up 1/8 to 20-5/8 in late morning trading.
